ctx.x: Woody, on the other hand, advertised the fact that he was only the editor, he was proud of the fact--McKenney has salvaged the phrase 'musical idiot' which you may have in some of that material I sent you, Boyd once said, for a musical idiot, I've got

a great band.
Woody always kind of--he would never use that word, but always suggested that gee, I was a great editor, I think, and allowed my guys to have a good band. It's always made him sort of a hero for saying it. Enough of that, I guess.
I told you that I was going to talk more on this than any interviewer really should. I'm saying that to Morgenstern.
Well you're being helpful to me. It's not easy to talk about those times, really. Those were very important times for me.
